scope: Experimental1214ba on 1214az (#16 stage 6): chaos follows the host. While both peers are on the same map, the host publishes its arkCpntPlayerChaos points (+0x24) about once a second (D2CH) and the partner keeps its own equal in gameplay or scenes, so either mission end computes the same chaos level and next-map variant. Lab-only coop_chaos_points <n> (refused in product mode) sets the local points for takes.
